objective: Independently test whether CPVS numeric SourceID membership agrees with object identity by ZTF name, and verify the parent row-ordinal-to-catalog-ID mapping before interpreting membership discrepancies.
previous_knowledge_consumed: The CPVS parent snapshot contains 781602 catalog rows and source-backed derivation currently yields 741786 candidate IDs.
VizieR J/ApJ/932/118 Table 4 reports 730184 objects and defines its ID column as a catalog internal identifier with range 1-781604.
Zenodo record 3886372 describes SourceID as the internal identifier joining single-exposure photometry to Table 2.
Earlier diagnostics compared numeric ID sets and reported 11602 candidate-only IDs; exact membership remains unresolved.
A diagnostic combination of finite non-zero g/r mean magnitudes and periods happened to match the reference count, but this is not accepted as the paper's selection rule.

baseline.status: Read-only diagnostic only. No production selection, thresholds, baseline artifacts, labels, or release assets are changed.

expected_improvement: Parse the ZTF object names and internal IDs from the independent published Table 4 source.
Compare published ID-to-name pairs against the parent catalog's provisional row-ordinal-to-name mapping.
Report numeric-ID membership and provisional name-based membership separately, and refuse to interpret name membership as authoritative when the mapping check fails.
Retain mismatch samples and explicit diagnostics in the heavy scientific-validation artifact.

correctness.before: Numeric ID set comparison does not independently verify ID-to-object mapping.
correctness.after: Artifact reports exact ID-to-name alignment, out-of-range IDs, and name-based comparison only when mapping is validated.

reproducibility.after: Deterministic script and regression tests added to the heavy validation workflow.

evidence: Official Zenodo and VizieR documentation establish that both sources use internal catalog identifiers; the exact mapping must be verified from actual source records.
A diagnostic script, unit tests, and a heavy-workflow invocation are added in this PR.
validation.blocker: Run focused tests and full source-backed heavy validation; inspect resulting ID-to-name alignment and do not declare CPVS exact reconstruction resolved without a reproducible result.

findings: A mismatch between the parent row-ordinal mapping and published internal catalog IDs could invalidate numeric membership comparison or candidate-to-object provenance.
This hypothesis is not yet confirmed; the new source-backed audit is intended to test it.
Object-level scientific comparisons should use stable astronomical object identifiers/names as an independent check alongside numeric internal IDs.
Do not treat catalog row ordinals as equivalent to internal IDs unless source-backed ID-to-object mapping is verified.
Keep candidate counts, numeric membership, and name-based membership separate in diagnostic reports.

open_blockers: Run tests/test_cpvs_object_identity_audit.py and the complete CI suite.
Complete heavy source-backed validation and review generated object_identity_audit.json.
CPVS exact reconstruction remains unresolved until the 11602 candidate-only discrepancy is explained.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not change selection thresholds or tune filters to force the target count.
Do not accept row-ordinal-to-internal-ID equivalence without source-backed validation.
Do not merge the diagnostic change until its tests pass.
Preserve v0.2.0 and v1.0.1 baselines and keep CPVS validation fail-closed.
